purpose.domain_detail: Brazilian SIV (Sistema de Informações de Vendas) - Sales Information System. Generates reports (Extrato) for sales representatives, supervisors, sales managers, and district managers.
purpose.summary: This program is a web-based COBOL CGI screen (PH070121) that renders an HTML form for generating sales extract reports in a Brazilian SIV system. It allows users to select sales team structure, date ranges, day-of-week filters, and excluded sectors/days. The program uses an HTML preprocessor to embed HTML directly in COBOL source.
